name: Amwell
description: Amwell provides patient telehealth services and a technology-enabled care platform for providers and payers. Its enterprise platform connects virtual, automated and in-person care with EHRs, patient portals, clinical programs, applications and devices through customer-specific healthcare deployments.
agentUseSummary: Amwell cannot yet be connected to Relay agents because patient access is a personal, PHI-bearing clinical identity, while the Amwell platform is separately contracted and configured for provider and payer customers. Relay will not collect patient credentials, automate care, or infer generic API authority from the platform's open architecture and enterprise integration claims.

blocked.label: Connect an Amwell patient account
blocked.description: Relay does not collect patient usernames, passwords, access tokens, MFA keys, payment information, session cookies, insurance details, location attestations or telehealth enrollment credentials.

blocked.label: Automate Amwell care
blocked.description: Relay does not select providers, schedule or conduct visits, submit symptoms, request diagnoses or prescriptions, participate in automated-care chats, consent to treatment, message care teams or make medical decisions.

blocked.label: Access Amwell health data
blocked.description: Relay does not read, download, transmit or alter patient records, clinical chat content, visit media, diagnoses, treatment information, prescriptions, insurance data, device data or other protected health information.

blocked.label: Control the Amwell enterprise platform
blocked.description: Relay does not provision customer tenants, EHR or patient-portal integrations, clinical programs, users, workflows, applications, devices or care operations without a customer-specific Amwell agreement and approved technical interface.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No action is exposed under the Amwell identity until an authorized provider or payer customer and Amwell establish a bounded non-clinical integration contract for Relay.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts no Amwell patient credential, health record, clinical workflow, enterprise tenant, EHR integration, application, device or care operation in OpenClaw.
Relay mounts no Amwell patient credential, health record, clinical workflow, enterprise tenant, EHR integration, application, device or care operation in Hermes.

providerSetup.blocker: Amwell's patient-facing services are credentialed telehealth and automated-care experiences offered on behalf of healthcare providers, health plans, employers and other customers. The current terms grant personal, non-commercial use, require users to protect passwords, access tokens and MFA keys, describe location and treatment consent, and cover medical records, diagnosis, therapy, follow-up and health-data sharing. The privacy policy confirms that the platform collects personal health information and may process PHI under a HIPAA notice. The Amwell enterprise platform separately targets providers and payers, embeds digital care in EHRs and other infrastructure, and connects applications and devices through an open architecture. Public materials route prospective organizations through contact and existing clients through a customer community; they do not publish a general self-service developer registration, OAuth authorization, endpoint, scope, token, schema, webhook or revocation contract for Relay. An open enterprise architecture is not transferable authority. Enabling a connector requires a signed customer agreement, tenant design, BAA and data-processing terms, clinical governance and Amwell-approved technical interfaces. Clinical actions cannot be made safe by an approval prompt alone.
providerSetup.nextAction: Do not request patient credentials, payment, insurance, location, health information, visit content, records, treatment consent, provider authority, customer tenant details, EHR access or device access; create or use accounts; contact sales as the customer; automate web or mobile UI; or show Connect. Reconsider only for an authorized provider or payer customer after Amwell and the customer approve Relay's exact non-clinical use case, execute required commercial, BAA and data-processing agreements, and provide current official integration documentation, a test tenant, tenant-scoped machine credentials, schemas, signed-event verification, limits, permitted data and explicit revocation. Diagnosis, treatment and autonomous clinical decisions must remain blocked.

evidence.supports: Amwell routes individuals to patient telehealth services rather than presenting a developer registration or machine-authority flow.

Amwell's terms define customer-sponsored services, personal non-commercial use, credential security, patient enrollment, telehealth consent, medical records and clinical or automated-care interactions.
Amwell's privacy policy covers the platform, telemedicine registration, credentials, personal health information and PHI subject to a HIPAA notice.
Amwell presents its platform to providers and payers as an enterprise care environment integrated with EHRs, existing infrastructure and customer programs, with adoption led through contact.
Amwell describes Converge's open architecture, customer and innovator applications, EHR and portal integration, unified identity, clinical devices and regulated information exchange.
Amwell directs patients, existing clients and healthcare providers into separate support, customer-community and provider channels rather than a public developer console.
